scope: Daily lesson teaching quality: clarity, worked evidence, coverage of assigned methods, independent practice, readable layouts and progress safety.
rubric: A clear first action and stated conditions
Worked reasoning tied to the actual numbers or source
Known harder variants demonstrated before practice
Stable skill/question IDs and saved progress

mathImprovement: All 143 focused methods display worked reasoning in numbered steps. The whole-number optimum method uses a simpler title and explicitly derives its formerly unexplained constraint multipliers.
timing: New plans retain the full formula packet and reserve lesson time so the estimated combined session is at most 120 minutes. Saved active plans, their lesson minutes and clocks are retained.
preservation: No question/skill IDs, practice assignments, answer indices, choices, student settings or existing completed concept keys were changed. Only isolated QA accounts were used.

verification.layout: 325 real lesson components at 1280px and 390px; zero overflow, empty-table or SVG-label-clipping findings
verification.liveSavedSession: 15 prior answers, concept checkpoint, timing, deadline, uncertainty, retries and history preserved
verification.browser: Manual seasons, rock-order, Reading hard-variant and Math step views; screenshots in screenshots/lesson-completeness
verification.githubCI: Hosted runner previously blocked by account billing; equivalent checks passed locally

limits: These are editorial teaching grades, not a scaled-score prediction.
Existing question-bank calibration and full-section rehearsal are separate from the Daily lesson grade.
